brief: The non-Prague layer for CZ banking jobs/organisation signals rests on three legs: the Deník regional network (one edition per kraj, of which Moravskoslezský, Brněnský and Hradecký are mapped here) plus independent regional outlets such as Magazín PATRIOT and POLAR in Moravia-Silesia; municipal and investment-agency publishers (Ostrava city press releases, Invest in Ostrava's centre directory, ABSL's annual sector report) which quantify shared-service-centre footprints in Brno, Ostrava and Hradec Králové before employers announce anything; and the employee-voice layer, where Atmoskop.cz is clearly the highest-value asset — stable per-employer numeric IDs, review paging and a statistics trend page, with reviews explicitly discussing reorganisation, turnover and layoff fear. Job boards (Jobs.cz sector+kraj filters, cz.indeed.com, Jooble, Práce.cz) are best treated as a counting instrument: regional vacancy volumes per bank are the cleanest early proxy for back-office build-out or contraction, and Eurofound's restructuring database provides a structured cross-check. Main weaknesses this run: no standalone Czech forum was found, Glassdoor is assumed login-walled and scraping-prohibited (unverified), Brno Daily and Ostravan.cz could not be confirmed, and the union / Úřad práce mass-layoff channels — likely the earliest hard signals — remain entirely unmapped.
